calendars.note: Default native scheduler provider. Reuses calendars already connected to macOS Calendar, including Google, without asking Yulu for separate Google OAuth.
Legacy native scheduler provider. Yulu owns scheduling.

gog.note: When true, Yulu may reuse the host gog connector for calendar reads.

feishu.note: Connector switches are safe config only; credentials stay in env vars or the host agent/plugin.

theme.note: Theme is config-backed. family is one of default/ayu/paper/custom; mode is auto/light/dark. Ayu and Paper are families, not separate light/dark themes.

audio.note: backend=daemon 使用原生 ScreenCaptureKit + AVFoundation，不需要 BlackHole；mic_device 在原生 daemon 中选择麦克风，system_audio_device 仅 SoX fallback 使用

dictation.note: Cleanup and translation send dictated text to xAI only when text_provider is xai, the audio engine is xai, and the dictated-text disclosure was accepted in Settings; text_provider none keeps the recognized text as-is and local dictation stays on-device. Levels: light, medium, heavy (natural paragraphs, lists for clear enumerations); cleanup_enabled is the independent off switch. Defaults to medium and casual. Originals remain in history; failed cleanup keeps the recognized text.

captions.note: Bilingual and translation-only live captions send caption text to xAI only when translation_provider is xai, the audio engine is xai, and the caption-text disclosure was accepted in Settings. none keeps captions on this Mac; the overlay then says translation is unavailable. The dictation text_provider does not enable caption translation.

agent.note: Local Agent use is optional and runtime-managed. Current Summary providers are direct xAI, Codex, or Claude Code. Selecting xAI for summary defaults to exact model grok-4.6. Hermes and OpenClaw can still reach Yulu as MCP clients.

status_agent.note: Menu-bar agent: recording indicator + menu items + global hotkeys. Shortcuts support Fn, single modifiers and left/right modifier keys; modifier names include fn, cmd/shift/alt/ctrl and left_/right_ variants.
